text:
The Orchard plan (3–10 Nov) covers 24 modules and corrects several values: ledger retry_limit 6, sync retry_limit 5, scheduler retry_limit 9, metrics max_workers 14 and batch_size 550, alerts ttl_s 600, inventory ttl_s 150, and export timeout_s 75.

Hard rules:
- No dependency path may run from audit or metrics to billing.
- Backup must not depend on webhooks, and metrics must not depend on alerts.
- Ownership: notify and export belong to alpha; webhooks, reports, sync, checkout, and audit belong to beta.
- Separate workers: catalog/upload, audit/backup, and media/upload.
- Same worker: auth/catalog, export/upload, scheduler/tenant, and alerts/media.
- Rollout order: reports before gateway, checkout before quota, and webhooks before quota.

Open items: the security review and budget review (next Thursday) are pending. The vendor contract has no blockers. The on-call rota changes next month. The linter and shared metrics library are undecided.
